name: Eleanor Davies
bio:
Eleanor's journey into motorsport PR began unconventionally, after a brief stint as a local journalist covering community events. She stumbled into the world of racing when covering a small-scale rally event and was immediately captivated by the high-octane atmosphere. Realising that she craved the adrenaline of the sport, she shifted her focus and landed a role as a junior publicist for a Formula 3 team, honing her skills in crisis management and media relations.

Over the years, Eleanor has developed a reputation for her calm and collected demeanour, even under intense pressure. Her collaborative approach to team media strategy makes her a valuable asset. She aims to present a cohesive and genuine image for Williams Racing. She thrives on building strong relationships with journalists and fans, believing that transparent communication is key to sustaining long-term success and loyalty. What sets Eleanor apart is her ability to blend a sharp strategic mind with a deeply empathetic nature.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, wavy with a side part
physical.description: Eleanor has a warm smile and a professional, yet approachable, demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down ideas.
Has a collection of racing helmets displayed in her office.
Prefers Earl Grey tea, always, and refuses all other kinds of tea.
